description: Switch thrown under a standing train, which then leaves facing through it (#289 review 2b): an EU07 with three coaches stands cold across zwr01 on td.scn, the locomotive on track 2, the last coaches over the switch, which is set to track 2. 5 s after the start the switch is thrown to track 1; then the driver gets the order to go, into the station, facing through the switch. The axles on the switch keep the way to track 2, the last coach's rear bogie comes to the points after the throw and takes track 1: physics.derailment monitor tells in the log that the coach derails. The AI scans its route from the last vehicle along the way its axles run on, to track 2 where the locomotive is, never through track 1; the test passes when the locomotive runs onto tdo_n109, the last track before the exit signal of track 2. (Shunting, the AI runs past that signal at stop by a few metres, with nothing thrown and on staging as well, so the case doesn't wait for the stop.)
